description:
Update a blog post by id.

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to view the blog post and its corresponding space. Permission to update blog posts in the space.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the blog post to be updated. If you don't know the blog post ID, use Get Blog Posts and filter the results.

200.description: Returned if the requested blog post is successfully updated.

base.description: Base url of the Confluence site.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description:
Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing
from the request.

404.description:
Returned if:
- The provided blog post does not exist
- The user does not have permissions to view the blog post
- The user does not have the needed permissions to update a blog post in the space
